patterns.pattern: Pushing without running `pnpm format:fix` across the change, so CI's Lint job finds the errors first, e.g. generated SVGs Biome couldn't parse; or running the undocumented `pnpm lint` instead of the format script

Giving a new control its own focus, hover, selected or border styles instead of an existing component's variants, e.g. `ButtonGroupChoice` before it took `Button`'s secondary and primary variants and focus ring
Existing `CLAUDE.md` rule not followed: a diagram not updated in the PR that changed the flow it shows
Existing `CLAUDE.md` rule not followed: comments longer than their reason, or restating what the classes say, e.g. exact widths in the hand's comment
Existing `CLAUDE.md` rule not followed: a state left unchecked in a layout change, e.g. the empty hand collapsing before the first deal
Existing `CLAUDE.md` rule not followed: a control built from buttons with a role instead of the native input, e.g. radio buttons as `<button role="radio">`
Existing `raise-pr` rule not followed: a PR description's Details longer than a reviewer needs
Existing `run-retro` step 4 not followed: a drafted rule that names the incident's details rather than the principle, e.g. calling out `playwright test --list`
Existing `run-retro` step 4 not followed: a drafted rule that doesn't say what it leaves out, so it could be read too widely, e.g. "do a real run" read as "run the E2E games more"

A new page built to the letter of the issue but thinner than the sites around it, e.g. a Storybook Introduction of three bare links, before it took nav-styled links, its purpose and guides to writing stories
A PR that changes a tool with visible output, such as the screenshot script, without an example of that output in its description
Existing `raise-pr` rule not followed: a screenshot left out of a PR as impossible to take, without suggesting an issue to make it possible
Existing `run-retro` step 4 not followed: proposing a new check rather than extending the one the repo already runs, e.g. a new CI path filter beside the `changes` job
Existing `run-retro` step 4 not followed: proposing a script for something an allowed tool already does, e.g. curl-free URL checks for docs sites web fetch is already allowed to read

Existing `manage-branch` rule not followed: resuming an existing issue branch with `git checkout` and `git merge main` instead of `git switch` and `update-branch.ts`, as the skill wasn't loaded when not creating a branch
Removing a config file after checking only one tool that reads it, e.g. deleting `.npmrc` because pnpm stopped reading it, while npm still needed its `engine-strict` for the `engines` guard
Running a command that prompts when an allowlisted one does the same job, e.g. `npm view` instead of `pnpm view`
